2.49.10
List.Height
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The List.Height element specifies the height of a List. This element is optional.
If the List.Height element is present, its value MUST be a non-negative RdlSize. If this element is not
present, its value is interpreted as the height of the list's container minus the value of the List.Top
element of this list, if specified.
Following is the parent element of the List.Height element.
Parent elements
List
The following is the XML Schema definition of the List.Height element.
 <xsd:element name="Height" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0" />
